title: FixturePagedApiSdk Tool Definitions
description: LLM tool calling bindings for fixture-paged-api API

tools.name: catalog.listItems
tools.description:
The items, two to a page unless the caller asks for up to five, by
their ids or their stock, in order of their names unless the caller
sorts them by name or sku, either way. Pages: pass the result's `next` back as `cursor`, with the same `sort`, for the next page; `next` is null after the last.

cursor.description: The `next` of the previous page; absent for the first page.

items.description: UUID v4 with automatic base62 encoding for client-facing APIs

limit.description: The most items the page holds: 1 to 5, 2 when absent.

sort.description: The order of the page: a field, or - and a field for descending; ties break by id. A cursor holds the sort it was returned under. One of `name`, `-name`, `sku` or `-sku`; `name` when left out.

next.description: The cursor of the next page, to send as cursor; null after the last page.

tools.name: catalog.listParts
tools.description:
The parts, in order of their names unless the caller sorts them by
quantity, kept to the ones the caller's filters find (D106): a filter
on a field of each kind, beside a page and a sort. Pages: pass the result's `next` back as `cursor`, with the same `sort`, for the next page; `next` is null after the last. Filters: `filter` keeps the items its members match, a member per field (id, name, kind, quantity, weight, price, discontinued, madeAt, retiredOn, supplierId), each a value or an object of operators; pass the same `filter` with each `cursor`.

cursor.description: The `next` of the previous page; absent for the first page.

filter.description: The rows the list keeps: each member is a field (id, name, kind, quantity, weight, price, discontinued, madeAt, retiredOn, supplierId) holding a value, for equality, or an object of operators, and all of them hold at once.

discontinued.description: Filters by discontinued: a value it equals, or its operators (eq, ne, in, notIn).

in.description: The field is one of the values, at most 100.

ne.description: The field is not the value: every item eq leaves out, one whose field is null among them.

notIn.description: The field is none of the values, at most 100: every item in leaves out, one whose field is null among them.
